summary: Visual/style regression pass for MedAssistix Turkish clinical prototype after switch to Fraunces (headings) + Nunito Sans (body), warmer palette, larger radius, pill CTAs, softer transitions. Verified landing, signup, dashboard, research workspace /arastirma/c1, evidence /kanit (with search 'öksürük'), /ilaclar, /ilaclar/p6, /gecmis, /paketler, /profil, admin /yonetim across light + dark themes at 1440 / 1280 / 768 / 390. Verified font loading, Turkish character rendering, no horizontal overflow, theme toggle (landing + sidebar), demo login (physician + admin), evidence search, and research quick-action flow.

visual_regression_findings.fonts: h1 computed fontFamily = 'Fraunces, Georgia, serif'; body = '"Nunito Sans", sans-serif'. Fraunces renders Turkish glyphs (ş, ğ, ı, İ, ö, ü, ç) cleanly in headings ('İyi günler, Dr. Elif.', 'Kanıt Ara', 'İlaçlar', 'Paketler', 'Geçmiş'). Body copy readable.
visual_regression_findings.palette_light: Body bg rgb(251,250,248) warm off-white; fg rgb(37,50,65) deep soft navy. Brand sage/teal pills (Araştırma sürüyor, Hekim: Doğrulandı) render with good contrast.
visual_regression_findings.palette_dark: Body bg rgb(17,23,29); theme toggle (both landing-theme-toggle and sidebar-theme-toggle) transitions smoothly ~400ms. All surfaces (sidebar, cards, header) switch together.
visual_regression_findings.overflow: No horizontal overflow at 1440 / 1280 / 768 / 390 on any tested route (scrollWidth - clientWidth = 0 everywhere).
visual_regression_findings.cta: Primary CTAs on landing ('Ücretsiz denemeye başla') pill-shaped; secondary outlined. Dialog login options tactile with soft radii.
visual_regression_findings.transitions: 280ms interactive + 400ms theme transitions observed smooth; no jank. fade-up on cards present on dashboard/arastirma.

functional_sanity.demo_login_physician: PASS - landing-login-button -> login-dialog -> login-as-physician navigates to /
functional_sanity.evidence_search_oksuruk: PASS - 4 evidence results rendered (TR Dizin + Europe PMC) and 'öksürük' added to history
functional_sanity.quick_action_tedavi: PASS - quick-action-tedavi in /arastirma/c1 appended Hekim sorusu + response flow

critical_code_review_comments: tailwind.config.js maps font-mono to Nunito Sans (matches brief, loses tabular numerics via family). Numeric columns rely only on CSS `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` applied via .font-mono rule in index.css line 69 — works, but note any component expecting a true mono font (e.g., diff/log views) will now render in sans. Not an issue for the current pages.
index.html meta theme-color still '#000000' — consider updating to match new warm palette (#FBFAF8) for mobile browser chrome in light mode.
index.css line 68 uses !important on h1-h4 font-weight/letter-spacing — works but discourages override; acceptable for a visual pass.
test_credentials: Demo-only (client-side mock) via /tanitim login dialog: login-as-physician / login-as-admin. No real credentials required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is frontend-only mock. Login via landing-login-button -> login-dialog -> login-as-physician (or login-as-admin). Theme toggles: landing-theme-toggle on /tanitim, sidebar-theme-toggle inside AppShell. Evidence page testids: evidence-search-input, evidence-search-button, evidence-result-{id}. Research quick actions: quick-action-{tedavi|ilac|ayirici|tetkik}, composer-send-button. All tested routes render with no horizontal overflow at 1440/1280/768/390 and no console errors. Fonts (Fraunces + Nunito Sans) load from Google Fonts; verify Google Fonts not blocked if re-testing in a sandboxed network.
